name: katip-kalkan
description: For Turkish lawyers: Katip masks names, T.C. kimlik numbers, addresses and health data in client documents on your computer, so Claude works with placeholders such as [AD SOYAD-1] instead of the values Katip finds, then puts the real names back into your final document. Avukatlar için yerel KVKK kişisel veri maskeleme.
